newsitem.title: USA: Glickman meets with Wisconsin dairy producers.
newsitem.headline: Glickman meets with Wisconsin dairy producers.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman Tuesday met with Wisconsin lawmakers and dairy farmers about the National Cheese Exchange, which critics charge is a less than fair way of pricing cheese.
"I thought it was a very, sound productive meeting with a very difficult but important problem that we need to resolve," Glickman told USDA radio.
"The goal is to find a different method to price milk, but we have to get public comment first. I think we've indicated our desire to move away from the cheese exchange."
USDA is getting public comment now on whether to delink the exchange as a factor in its dairy formula price.
Critics say that cheese prices at the Green Bay, Wisc. exchange are manipulated by large dairy product firms and do not reflect the actual supply and demand for milk and cheese.
